しても.en: even if it does; even if it does

bloques.titulo: The Commission also considers that the Commission's proposal for a directive on the protection of the environment is not an appropriate one.
texto: It is equal to «though» or «even if». Distinguish the (unconfirmed) hypothesis from a real fact with the "hare" (hare).
The security review cannot be omitted, although the plan is delayed.
(Although there are many opinions against, it should not be concluded without hearing the reasons.)

frases.ja: 反対 意見 が 多い と しても、理由 を 聞かず に 結論 を 出す べき では ありません。

frases.en: Although there are many opinions against it, it should not be concluded without hearing the reasons.
